entity.name: Dubai air taxi launch tracker
entity.meta_description: Not flying yet. As of 22 August 2026 Dubai's air taxi has a certified vertiport (VDX, 7 Jul 2026) and a target of first passengers before the end of 2026. Every milestone on the road to launch, dated and sourced.
